goal: Rubric grading API in backend/routers/ and frontend/src/app/dai-noi/giao-vien/
summary: Implemented authoritative teacher rubric scoring across the 4 core historical reasoning criteria (S1 spatial reasoning, S2 temporal dimension, S3 primary evidence, S4 historical argumentation on a 0-3 scale each) with real reviewer attribution, timestamps, qualitative feedback notes, and immutable audit revision tracking. Protected against client-side devtools tampering: unauthorized learners/students cannot forge a graded status during submission creation or offline batch sync, and direct grading calls from unauthorized roles strictly return HTTP 403 Forbidden. Implemented audit history retrieval (GET /api/v1/imperial/teacher/submissions/{id}/audit) and connected frontend grading drawer with optimistic UI updates, error alert banners, and live audit revisions.

invariants_enforced.rubric_scoring_scale_0_to_3: Each rubric criterion (S1_spatial, S2_temporal, S3_evidence, S4_argument) is strictly validated as an integer within 0..3. Values outside this range, non-integers, or booleans fail immediately with HTTP 400 INVALID_RUBRIC_SCORE.
invariants_enforced.reviewer_attribution_and_timestamp: When graded, the submission atomically records graded_by=current_user.id, graded_at=now(utc), teacher qualitative feedback note, and increments row_version.
invariants_enforced.immutable_audit_logging_and_revisions: Every grading action and subsequent revision appends an immutable entry to audit_logs (resource_type='imperial_submission', action='rubric_grade') recording before/after diffs, scores, reviewer ID, and timestamps.
invariants_enforced.anti_abuse_devtools_forge_block: Client devtools attempting to submit fabricated statuses ('status': 'graded', 'score': 12.0, 'rubric_scores': {...}) have these fields completely ignored by the server during activity creation and batch sync, forcing status='submitted' and score=None.
invariants_enforced.role_scoped_authorization: Only authenticated staff/teachers (STAFF_ROLES) can execute grading mutations or inspect submission audit trails; learner and guest callers strictly receive HTTP 403 Forbidden; unauthenticated callers receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

changes.description: Added ImperialSubmissionAuditOut schema with model validator populating reviewer_id, submission_id, resource_id, and audit diff payloads.

Enhanced grade_submission to enforce strict 0-3 integer criterion validation (rejecting booleans), capture pre- and post-mutation state diffs, append immutable audit log records atomically, and increment row_version. Added get_submission_by_id and get_submission_audit_history services.
Added GET /api/v1/imperial/teacher/submissions/{submission_id} and GET /api/v1/imperial/teacher/submissions/{submission_id}/audit endpoints protected by get_staff_user dependency.
Added fetchTeacherSubmissionsFromBackend, gradeSubmissionWithApi, fetchSubmissionAuditFromBackend, and mapBackendSubmissionToClient while preserving offline/test initial fixtures.
Integrated backend grading API call with loading and error states, negative abuse role checks (preventing non-teachers from grading), reviewer attribution display, and audit history revisions drawer.
Created comprehensive test suite covering rubric 0-3 scoring, reviewer ID/timestamp, audit log revisions, negative abuse devtools forge prevention, learner 403 blocks, and strict input validation.

test_details.name: test_teacher_rubric_scoring_success
test_details.assertion: Verifies teacher rubric scoring across S1-S4 criteria (0-3 scale), reviewer ID, timestamp, feedback note, and single submission retrieval.

test_details.name: test_submission_audit_history_and_revisions
test_details.assertion: Verifies that initial grading and subsequent re-grading append immutable audit records with state diffs and row_version tracking.

test_details.name: test_unauthorized_student_cannot_call_grading_api
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse: Learner/student accounts attempting to call the teacher grading API receive HTTP 403 Forbidden.

test_details.name: test_client_devtools_cannot_forge_graded_status_during_submission
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse: Injected devtools fields (status='graded', score=12.0) are completely ignored by the server, preserving status='submitted'.

test_details.name: test_unauthorized_student_cannot_view_audit_history
test_details.assertion: Learner and unauthenticated users are blocked from viewing submission audit trails (HTTP 403/401).

test_details.name: test_rubric_validation_rejects_invalid_values
test_details.assertion: Out-of-scale rubric scores (>3 or <0) and non-existent submissions return HTTP 400 and 404 respectively.

test_details.name: test_teacher_can_request_resubmission
test_details.assertion: Teachers can return submissions with status 'resubmit_requested' and constructive guidance recorded in the audit trail.
